text:
Served: 2 slices of multigrain toast (~200 kcal), 2 fried eggs (~180), about 1/4 avocado (~60), a butter portion (~35), a vanilla yogurt cup (~150, likely a Brownes yogurt around 160g), and tea with milk (~30). That totals about 655 kcal.

Leftover: almost everything was eaten. Only crumbs, a little yogurt residue and the butter wrapper remain, which I estimate at about 15 kcal.

Eaten: about 640 kcal.
- Protein: toast 8 g, eggs 13 g, yogurt 7 g, milk 1 g, avocado 1 g, for about 30 g.
- Carbohydrate: toast 34 g, yogurt 22 g, milk 2 g, avocado 1 g, for about 59 g.
- Fat: eggs 13 g, butter 4 g, avocado 6 g, toast 3 g, yogurt 4 g, milk 1 g, for about 31 g.
